issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台从源码抓到 12f，只渲染出开头读布景的静止段，三级动量链完全没出现
砸落的标题是卡名大写占位 "CHAIN REACTION"，像调试标签
侧边栏是深灰底 + 灰色骨架条，地板是一根 6px 灰实条，背景纯平
卡片弹起时地面没有任何反馈（无接触影），落地硬停无 squash，读不出重量
高速下落与横向撞滑没有运动模糊，末卡歪斜是线性插值
changes: 补 DOMINO_CASCADE_DURATION = 150（36f 读布景 + 64f 三级链 + 50f 真静止），撞击帧 51/78、5f 错峰、12f 抛物线、震幅 10/6px 全部不变
标题换成眉题 "Q3 PRODUCT REVIEW" + 120px 主标题 "Everything, connected."（系统字体 700、随字号负字距）；落地 7f 压扁 0.9→1 带过冲回弹
侧边栏重做为完整导航（logo、6 项图标导航、选中态、Usage 进度条），右缘投影到画布；地面换成发丝线 + 向下渐隐的地面影 + 柔光背景
每张卡加地面接触影（离地越高越小越淡），卡片阴影随高度增大，落地 4f squash 0.965
砸落段竖向、撞滑段横向按速度挂 SpeedBlur（静止帧零滤镜）；末卡歪 3° 改不对称缓动进出
issuesEn: No exported duration; the workbench grabbed 12f from the source, so only the static opening rendered and the three-stage chain never appeared
The falling title was the card name in caps, 'CHAIN REACTION', reading as a debug label
The sidebar was dark grey with grey skeleton bars, the floor a solid 6px grey bar, and the background flat
Bouncing cards gave the floor no feedback (no contact shadow) and stopped dead on landing with no squash, so they had no weight
The fast fall and the sideways slide had no motion blur, and the last card's tilt was a linear interpolation
changesEn: Added DOMINO_CASCADE_DURATION = 150 (36f setup + 64f chain + 50f true hold); impact frames 51/78, 5f stagger, 12f parabola and 10/6px shake unchanged
Title is now an eyebrow 'Q3 PRODUCT REVIEW' plus a 120px headline 'Everything, connected.' (system font 700, size-based negative tracking); it squashes 0.9→1 on landing with an overshoot over 7f

Sidebar rebuilt as full navigation (logo, six icon items, active state, usage meter) casting a shadow onto the canvas; the floor is now a hairline with a fading ground shadow over a soft-light backdrop
Each card gets a ground contact shadow that shrinks and fades with height, a card shadow that grows with lift, and a 4f 0.965 squash on landing
Velocity-driven SpeedBlur on the vertical fall and the horizontal slide (no filter on resting frames); the 3° tilt now eases in and out asymmetrically
